解答 方程组两边同时对 $t$ 求导可得

$$\frac{dx}{dt}=f''(t)，\frac{dy}{dt}=e^tf''(t)+(e^t-1)f'(t)，\text{可得 }\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}=\frac{e^tf''(t)+(e^t-1)f'(t)}{f''(t)}$$

$x=f^\prime(t), y=e^tf^\prime(t)-f(t)$（$f^{\prime\prime}(t)\ne0$），求 $\frac{dy}{dx}$。 $-\frac1{f^{\prime\prime}(t)}$ $\frac t{f^{\prime\prime}(t)}$ $e^t+(e^t-1)f^\prime(t)$ $\frac{e^tf^{\prime\prime}(t)+(e^t-1)f^\prime(t)}{f^{\prime\prime}(t)}$ 解答 方程组两边同时对 $t$ 求导可得

$$\frac{dx}{dt}=f''(t)，\frac{dy}{dt}=e^tf''(t)+(e^t-1)f'(t)，\text{可得 }\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}=\frac{e^tf''(t)+(e^t-1)f'(t)}{f''(t)}$$
